title: K2 Style contract v1
description: A K2 Style is a folder: style.json (manifest, validated by #/$defs/manifest), tokens.json (non-color slots, #/$defs/tokens), and palettes/*.json (color + terminal slots, #/$defs/palette). Token values follow the W3C DTCG shape: { "$value": ..., "$type": ... }. scripts/build-styles.mjs validates these files and emits src/renderer/styles.generated.css.

id.description: Folder name and data-style attribute value.

name.description: User-facing name shown in Settings → Themes.

hidden.description: Still compiled, but left out of the Settings picker. For retired looks.

defaultPalettes.description: Per-scheme default palette, used when the user's chosen palette doesn't support the resolved scheme (e.g. Auto flips to light).

screenshot.description: Relative path to a preview image (required for community submissions).

gaps.description: True if the Style exposes the compact/regular/spacious gap control.

backdrop.description: True if the Style uses translucent materials (backdrop-filter). Surfaces hosting WebGL always use --color-bg (opaque) regardless.

dials.description: Optional user-adjustable knobs surfaced in Settings → Themes (e.g. Glass tint opacity).

token.description: CSS custom property the dial writes, e.g. --material-tint-opacity.

unit.description: CSS unit appended to the value when writing the token, e.g. "px".

default.description: Value used when the user hasn't adjusted the dial. Must lie within [min, max].

tokens.description: Non-color slots. Every group listed in required must be present with every slot the generator's REQUIRED_TOKEN_SLOTS lists — missing slots fail the build loudly.

control.description: Sizes for the shared form controls: checkbox, radio, switch, slider.

chamfer.description: 45-degree corner cuts: surface, control, chip, send. 0px is a plain corner.

tile.description: Opaque tile surface: fill, raised, edge, sheen, shadow. Shadow slots use 0 0 #0000 when off, never the keyword none.

font.description: ui, display, code. The code slot emits --font-code because Tailwind v4 owns --font-mono.

type.description: Type scale: micro, xs, sm, md, lg, xl. Named type because Tailwind v4 owns --text-*.

gapPresets.description: Named spacing variants (surfaced as the density control when capabilities.gaps is true). Each preset overrides layout-domain slots only: gap.pane/tile/section, inset.window, divider.width/color. The base tokens are the implicit 'compact' preset.

editorTheme.description: Optional suggestion for the (independent) CodeMirror theme system.
